what_happened.line: The Finance Committee assigned two members to a subcommittee on debt policy and capital projects, to report back to the full committee.
Members reviewed Town Meeting, including amendments on deferring appropriations that were not accepted, and the Green Communities appropriation request.
A member reported the School Committee approved a one-time bus contract settlement and that unspent bus money may prepay outside placements.
A resident asked about the TC Passios architect contract; the reply was that the contract is moving forward near the amount Town Meeting appropriated.
The committee set its July 9 meeting as the reorganization meeting; no votes were recorded and the meeting adjourned.

why_it_matters: The debt policy subcommittee will shape how the town weighs borrowing for capital projects, which affects future debt payments on tax bills.
The bus settlement and prepaid outside placements may ease school costs in fiscal year 2021, and the TC Passios design contract commits money to a building project during financial uncertainty.
